claim: Graphical denial socket remains non-listening while a forked pre-exec child inherits its descriptor
cause: UnixListener::bind starts listening. A concurrent fork retains that open file description even after the parent closes it, until child exec/exit. CLOEXEC does not prevent pre-exec inheritance.
repair: Bind AF_UNIX stream inode without calling listen; atomically request CLOEXEC on Linux. Retain existing private permissions, owner/type, connect-refused and inode-stability checks.
regression: Fork while the same initialization descriptor is alive; child signals ready and holds inherited descriptor while parent performs normal verification. Old listening implementation fails, bound-only implementation passes. Child uses async-signal-safe syscalls and parent owns bounded release and failure cleanup.
test_fixture_correction: Standalone hidden-mount test now creates explicit private directories; it previously depended on another test setting process-global umask. Production private_dir unchanged.
